description: Household comparison (2-12 people, one insurer for all, household total) with the engine body { year:2027, members:[{ birthYear, postcode, bfs?, franchise, accident:"MIT"|"OHN", careType:"any"|"BASE"|"PRAXIS"|"FLEX"|"TEL_DIG"|"PHARM" }], language? }: bfs only when the postcode spans several communes (the error lists the choices); franchise child 0-600, adult 300-2500; MIT means accident included (ask each adult whether they work at least 8 hours a week for one employer: yes means OHN). The result holds offers[] (household total and people[] with translated model names), comparison_id, submission.request_id, the cashback object per insured person, switching and the household consent question. Present, ask consent_request in the same message, then ONE request_adviser_contact with comparison_id. One person: compare_lamal_premiums.

members.description: 2-12 insured persons, no names or contact data (one person: prepareLamalQuote).

accident.description: MIT: accident included. Ask each adult whether they work at least 8 hours a week for one employer: yes means OHN.

bfs.description: Only when the postcode spans several communes; the error lists the choices.

name: compare_lamal_household

outputSchema.description: Household comparison with everything needed to present, ask consent and send.

accident_question.description: Ask before quoting: employees working at least 8 hours a week for the same employer usually exclude accident cover (accident_included false).

cashback.description: Premium reduction Swiss Premium Insurance grants to each insured person, only for requests made through an AI assistant, once a contract concluded through SPI is approved by the insurer. Premiums and ranking shown are the official ones, without the reduction.

changes_premium.description: The official premium used for the ranking is not altered; the client benefit is the reduction in benefit_form.

client_sentence.description: Say as provided in the client language. Quote: requested language only (texts=all for fr, de, it, en); full premiums route: four languages. null when disabled.

insured_persons.description: Household results only: number of insured persons.

basis.description: one_month_premium per insured person and contract; amount set by SPI after review.

rationale.description: Same languages as client_sentence; null when disabled.

data.description: Origin and freshness of the official data; manifest_url lists source files and the last official sync.

readable_url.description: Readable GET household page (/compare-household?…) for browsing tools.

submission.description: How to send the client-approved request. Keep comparisonToken private; never put it in a link.

client_messages.description: Quote and household: requested language only (texts=all for fr, de, it, en); full premiums route: four languages.

channel_labels.description: Localised {channel} values for email, phone and email_or_phone.

consent_confirmation.description: Fill {request_id} and {channel}; it says the request cancels nothing, the 30 November deadline and the free SPI help. The receipt also returns it filled (client_confirmation).

consent_request.description: Ask this once, in the same message as the offers, filling {insurer}, {model} and {premium} (household: {insurer}, {persons}, {premium} total); a reply giving an email or phone is the consent.

comparison.description: Legacy criteria; copy unchanged with comparisonToken when comparison_id is unavailable.

comparison_id_valid_until.description: comparison_id lifetime (30 days); results_url and adviser_url follow it. Prefer comparison_id over the token.

enabled.description: false: sending is disabled; offer adviser_url instead.

request_id.description: Fresh per response; copy it as request_id of the submission.

request_template.description: submitOfferRequest body to fill; contact.email and contact.phone are empty strings: fill the ones you have.

switching.description: Switching deadline and free SPI help (cancellation, premium subsidies). Say client_sentence with the offers; a request to SPI cancels nothing by itself.

client_sentence.description: Deadline, free cancellation help and free subsidy help; requested language only unless texts=all.

deadline.description: Date by which the cancellation must REACH the current insurer.

subsidy_sentence.description: Say it when the client mentions a modest income or asks about premium subsidies.

title: Compare official LAMal premiums for a household
